problem_type: desktop lane canvas read used the MCP alias instead of the canonical Pi verb
symptom: Visible Agent look_at_canvas calls failed or returned stale-looking answers while the canvas page contained nodes.
direct_cause: createDesktopLaneTools passed nomi_canvas_read to the Pi transport adapter, whose accepted identity is CANVAS_READ_CAPABILITY.aliases.pi (look_at_canvas).
class_root: The desktop lane hand-copied a transport alias instead of deriving the caller identity from the shared capability contract.
internal_only_reason: The invariant is an internal shared capability alias contract.
invariants: Each transport adapter receives the alias declared for its surface by the capability contract.
The desktop Pi lane uses the Pi alias and MCP continues to use the MCP alias.
A read failure never becomes an inferred canvas answer in the visible Agent reply.
generality_proof: All desktop canvas reads converge through createDesktopLaneTools and the shared CANVAS_READ_CAPABILITY aliases; no caller is allowed to spell a transport name locally.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Bind the shared Pi alias to the desktop read adapter.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Real lane fixture now calls look_at_canvas and asserts the port executes once.
The adapter compares calls against CANVAS_READ_CAPABILITY.aliases.pi.

recurrence.reason: Any hand-copied alias in another desktop adapter can recreate the same silent routing failure.

prevention.invariant: Pi transport identity is read from CANVAS_READ_CAPABILITY.aliases.pi.
prevention.failure_mode: A mismatched alias is rejected by the adapter and the lane returns a structured failure.
prevention.strategy: Use the shared contract constant at the adapter call site and test the real lane boundary.

legacy_paths.rationale: The fix corrects the in-place caller routing; no persisted alias or parallel implementation was introduced or removed.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency controls the alias identity.

migration: No persisted data stores the adapter alias; existing sessions retry through the corrected live lane.
residual_risks: Real Electron retest must confirm empty, multi-node and cold-start page states after the fix.
